data.title: 妮芙 · 音乐盒的旋律
data.description: 音乐盒的发条转了几圈，她便安静地等着曲子开始。熟悉的旋律响起时，妮芙跟着轻轻哼了一小段。
data.camera: 中近景，音乐盒位于前景
data.promptProse: At a small parlor table covered in embroidered lace, Nymph gingerly winds the key of an ornate wooden music box, watching a spinning metal carousel with sparkling, fascinated eyes. Soft golden lamp light reflects off miniature brass gears, ribbons, and her curved horns, creating an enchanting fairy-tale moment of childhood wonder.
data.animaCaption: Seated at the lace-draped parlor table, she gently turns the key of an ornate wooden music box and watches its spinning carousel with sparkling, fascinated eyes. Warm golden lamplight glints across the miniature brass gears.
